plugin.name: Selkies
plugin.description: Selkies remote desktops in a Termix tab, with sound: linuxserver's docker-baseimage-selkies containers or Selkies' own server.

tab.title: Selkies
tab.noHost: Pick a host with Selkies turned on.

restart.title: Restart the desktop?
restart.description: Restarts Selkies and its desktop session on the host. Use it when the desktop was logged out or stopped responding. Apps open in the desktop close without saving, and everyone connected to this host's desktop is disconnected.

stop.title: Stop the desktop?
stop.description: Stops Selkies and its desktop session on the host now, instead of waiting for the idle timer. Apps open in the desktop close without saving, and everyone connected to this host's desktop is disconnected. Opening the desktop again starts it.

tab.browserHint: Microphone, gamepads, fullscreen and file downloads work in the browser window.

app.title: The desktop opens in your browser
app.hint: The Termix app can't show the desktop inside the app, so it opens in your phone's browser. It still goes through Termix, so it works wherever the app does. The link is only for you and stops working when you close this tab or press Reconnect.

errors.generic: The desktop could not be opened.
errors.disabled: Selkies is turned off on this server.
errors.notEnabled: Selkies is not turned on for this host.
errors.notSelkies: The configured address did not report active Selkies WebSocket mode. Check the port and path.
errors.unreachable: The Selkies container did not answer. Check the address, port and connection route.
errors.unauthorized: The Selkies container refused the login. Check the username and password.
errors.tokenRequired: The Selkies server is in secure mode and wants a valid access token. Check the access token in the host's Selkies login.
errors.websocketModeInactive: The Selkies server is in WebRTC mode, which can't go through Termix. Switch it to WebSocket mode.
errors.forbidden: You may not connect to this host.
errors.tooManySessions: Too many Selkies desktops are open on this server. Close one and try again.
errors.notManaged: Restarting or stopping the desktop needs Start and stop Selkies automatically turned on for this host.
errors.restartFailed: The desktop could not be restarted.
errors.stopFailed: The desktop could not be stopped.

tab.stopped: The desktop is stopped. Start it again when you need it.

hosts.title: Selkies
hosts.description: Remote desktop from a Selkies server, such as linuxserver's webtop or Selkies' own images.
hosts.schemeHelp: The linuxserver images serve HTTPS on 3001 and plain HTTP on 3000. Selkies' own server uses 8080.
hosts.pathHelp: The path Selkies is served under, like /desktop/ (the container's SUBFOLDER). Leave / when it has none.
hosts.routeHelp: Through SSH the container can stay bound to 127.0.0.1 on the host.
hosts.ignoreCertHelp: The linuxserver images and Selkies' own server make their own certificate.
hosts.openInBrowserHelp: Adds a button to the tab that opens the container's own page in a new browser tab. Use it for the microphone, gamepads, fullscreen and file downloads, which the Termix tab can't offer. That page doesn't go through Termix: your browser connects to the container itself, so it only works where your browser can reach it, like on the same network or over a VPN. Sign in there with the container's login.
hosts.publicUrlHelp: Leave empty to use this host's address with the protocol, port and path above. Set it when your browser reaches the container under another address, like a reverse proxy or a VPN name.
hosts.usernameHelp: The container's CUSTOM_USER: abc on linuxserver images (used when empty), ubuntu on Selkies' own.
hosts.passwordHelp: The container's PASSWORD (or PASSWD). Leave empty when it has no login.
hosts.tokenHelp: Only for a Selkies server in secure mode (SELKIES_MASTER_TOKEN set): a session token from its token table, not the master token. Termix adds it on the server; the browser never sees it.
hosts.testSaveFirst: Save the host first, then test. The test uses the saved settings.
hosts.testUnsaved: Unsaved changes: the test uses the saved settings, so save first.
hosts.testOk: The container answered with the saved login.
hosts.manageContainerHelp: Starts an existing Docker container or systemd service through this host's SSH connection when you connect or test. Stops it after no plugin desktop is connected for the time below.
hosts.manageTypeDockerHelp: The SSH user must be able to run Docker without an interactive sudo prompt.
hosts.manageTypeSystemdUserHelp: Runs systemctl --user as the SSH user. Turn on lingering for that user (loginctl enable-linger) so the service keeps running after SSH disconnects.
hosts.manageTypeSystemdSystemHelp: Runs systemctl as the SSH user. It must be root, or allowed to start and stop the unit by a polkit rule; there is no password prompt.
hosts.serviceNameHelp: An existing unit on this host, such as selkies.service. Set up the service and its desktop session first.
hosts.containerNameHelp: An existing container on this host, such as webtop. Set up the image, ports and volumes in Docker first.
hosts.idleMinutesHelp: 1–1440 minutes; default 10. Connected desktops and transfers keep it running. Connections made directly to Selkies outside Termix cannot be detected.

connect.title: Connect to Selkies desktops
connect.description: Open Selkies desktops on hosts they may connect to.

enabled.label: Selkies desktops
enabled.description: Turn off to close every way in to Selkies desktops.
